description: This file defines a fragment class HomeBrowseFragment for an Android TV application. It utilizes the Leanback library to present a browse interface with categorized rows of media items, allows user interaction through clicks to start playback activities, and manages UI setup and event handling.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a categorized browsing interface for media content on Android TV, utilizing Leanback's BrowseSupportFragment.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's UI, builds media rows, and sets up user interaction listeners.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the UI elements such as title, brand color, and header transitions.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs and populates rows of media items grouped by categories.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Sets event listeners for item clicks and selections, handling media playback initiation and selection logging.
